name: Sbu Steps

replaces.name: StepsApp Pedometer
replaces.price_model: Free with ads; PRO auto-renewing subscription (price not in the public lookup)

replaces.name: Stompers: Walking Step Counter
replaces.price_model: Free; Super Stompers weekly 4.99 USD to yearly 59.99 USD with trial, coins and packs (rating from the it store, meta.json)

one_thing: Shows today's steps, the same number as Health, and how they add up over time.

features.name: Today's steps
features.description: One figure: today's steps from HealthKit cumulative sum (same dedup as Health), live updates from CMPedometer while open; distance and floors secondary in inkMuted.
features.reason: Free in StepsApp but the base of every paid view.

features.name: Trends and records
features.description: Week, month and year charts (Swift Charts), averages per day/weekday/hour, yearly total, best day, all from HKStatisticsCollectionQuery.
features.reason: 'Advanced analytics & insights' is StepsApp's main PRO feature; a subscriber cancelled when it was cut.

features.name: Advanced goals
features.description: Daily goal with 250-step increments, optional different goal per weekday.
features.reason: 'Advanced goals' is PRO; review asks for 250-step increments.

features.name: Streak with free freezes
features.description: Days at goal in a row; one freeze earned every 7 days up to a cap, never sold.
features.reason: Extra streak freezes are PRO; review asks for earned freezes instead of paid ones.

features.name: Same number as Health
features.description: Read only HealthKit totals (respecting the user's source priority, so Watch/Garmin data counts); explain in Settings how to set source priority in Health.
features.reason: Steps differ from Health/Watch, missing steps or days (14).

features.name: Nothing paid
features.description: Every feature free, no trial, no PRO.

features.name: Opens fast, never blank
features.description: Today figure from a cached snapshot, then refreshed; no blocking launch work.

features.name: Distance and floors from Health
features.description: Use HealthKit distanceWalkingRunning and flightsClimbed, never a stride estimate.

features.name: Watch data through Health
features.description: No watchOS target needed: Watch steps arrive in HealthKit.

features.name: No rating nags
features.description: No in-app rating prompts beyond the system's own limit, never on launch.

features.name: Widgets
features.description: Home and Lock Screen widgets with today's steps and goal (WidgetKit + HealthKit in the extension).
features.reason: Free in StepsApp; useful but not paid core.

features.name: Export CSV
features.description: Daily steps, distance, floors exported to a CSV file via ShareLink.

features.name: Wheelchair pushes
features.description: Count pushCount instead of steps when the user's Health wheelchair setting is on.

features.name: Day starts later (night shifts)
features.description: Optional day boundary shift for shift workers.
features.reason: Stompers research: day ending at 21:00 hurt night workers.

screens.name: Trends
elements: Swift Charts bar chart (accent bars, no rings)

screens.name: Health access
screens.purpose: Ask for read access when needed.

flows.name: First launch
steps: Today shows Motion count via CMPedometer

fields.name: date
fields.note: cache for widget/launch, rebuilt from HealthKit

data_model.storage: Health data is read from HealthKit, never copied beyond a small App Group cache for widgets; goal and streak in UserDefaults (App Group). Nothing on iCloud (5.1.3(ii)). Read-only HealthKit, no writes.

monetization.model: Freemium: free with ads, PRO auto-renewing subscription
monetization.price: Not in the public lookup; reviews do not quote prices
paywalled_features: Advanced analytics and insights (trends, yearly totals, averages)
monetization.notes: Step counting, daily goal, streaks, Health/Watch sync, widgets and export are free. The paid core is analytics + no ads, not the counter.

system_frameworks.name: HealthKit

review_risks.rule: 4.3(a) + 4.2.6 (lot rejection of 14/10, Resolution Center question 6 'why not a feature of another app')
review_risks.risk: Sbu Habits already reads HealthKit stepCount for step habits with goals and streaks: Steps looks like a feature of Habits from the same developer.
review_risks.mitigation: Decide before building: either Steps owns steps (trends, records, distance/floors) and Habits drops or links its step habit, or Steps is not built. State the split in review notes.

review_risks.risk: Step counters are saturated and Apple Health shows steps for free; StepsApp's counter itself is free, so the 'replaces a subscription' story is weak.
review_risks.mitigation: Lead with the paid core done free: yearly trends, records, per-weekday goals, earned freezes, numbers identical to Health.

review_risks.risk: Health data must not go to iCloud or be used for anything else.
review_risks.mitigation: Read-only HealthKit, no iCloud sync (ADR-0008 does not apply), only a local App Group cache; privacy label 'no data collected'.

review_risks.risk: HealthKit only for health and fitness, integrated with Health.
review_risks.mitigation: Category Health & Fitness, read-only, HealthKit usage strings IT/EN tied to Connect to Health button, asked when tapped.

review_risks.risk: Mandatory for new Health & Fitness apps.
review_risks.mitigation: Declare 'not a regulated medical device'; no health claims.
Numbers come straight from HealthKit; no calorie estimates or medical advice.

review_risks.risk: Must not imitate Activity rings or the Health app.
review_risks.mitigation: No rings; one SbuStat figure and plain bar charts.
Asked only on first need, with purpose strings.
